  "title": "Slow / choppy scrolling on latest version",
  "body": "### Preliminary checklist

- [X] I have read the [README](https://github.com/bromite/bromite/blob/master/README.md).
- [X] I have searched the existing issues for my problem. This is a new ticket, NOT a duplicate or related to another open issue.
- [X] I have updated Bromite to the latest version. The bug is reproducible on this latest version.

### Can the bug be reproduced with corresponding Chromium version?

No

### Bromite version

98.0.4758.108

### Device architecture

arm64

### Android version

11

### Device model

OnePlus 7T

### Changed flags

No flags changed

### Is this bug about the SystemWebView?

No

### Is this bug happening in an incognito tab?

Yes

### Is this bug caused by the adblocker?

No

### Is this bug a crash?

No

### Describe the bug

After recent update, slow performance.  Scrolling through - any - website is choppy, probably under 30fps... Seems lime 10.  Old version was fine.

### Steps to reproduce the bug

Update to latest version of arm64 Bromite

### Expected behavior

Smooth scrolling at device refresh rate (90hz).  High performance.

### Screenshots

_No response_",
